title: Run token claims
description: Claims of the short-lived signed token the runner mints once per run and Chaperone verifies on every call. Serialised as a JWS compact JWT: protected header {alg: EdDSA, typ: 'factory-run+jwt', kid}; alg 'none' and every other algorithm MUST be rejected. Chaperone trusts only these claims, never anything the agent says about itself. Verifier checks beyond this schema (docs/spec.md): signature against the pinned the runner key, sub == 'run:' + run_id, exp > now, exp > iat, jti not revoked, scope narrower than or equal to the profile and policy. RFC 9864 deprecates the polymorphic 'EdDSA' algorithm name in favour of 'Ed25519'; v0 pins 'EdDSA' because libraries lag. The alg string is part of the spec version: v1 moves to 'Ed25519'. Two issuers exist: 'runner.<instance>' (full runs) and 'chaperone.<instance>' (the Phase 1 interim host token, isolation 'host', profile.name 'host-interim'); verifiers pin the accepted issuers and keys explicitly.

iss.description: Signer. runner.<instance> for runs; chaperone.<instance> only for the interim host token.

exp.description: Expiry, seconds since the epoch (the plan's 'expires'). Tokens live for the run's wall-time budget plus a short grace, never longer.

jti.description: Unique token id: revocation key and ledger link.

name.description: Profile kind, or 'host-interim' for the Phase 1 ceiling of agents that run on the host without the runner.

digest.description: Digest of the signed generic profile artifact that was admitted. Required unless profile.name is 'host-interim'.

overlay_digest.description: Digest of the signed project overlay, when one applies.

brief_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the JCS (RFC 8785) form of the validated brief this run was derived from.

isolation.description: The tier the run actually got. 'host' means no sandbox (Phase 1 interim token); a 'host' token may request high-impact ops, but every one of them requires an approval.

task_scope.description: Decided by Chaperone from the brief's trusted fields, checked against profile and policy (docs/spec.md, 'Who derives task_scope'). Concrete values only: no wildcards, no unexpanded placeholders.

branch.description: The one branch the run may push (placeholders already expanded).
